verses.text: Joseph went to Pharaoh and said, “My father and brothers have arrived from Canaan with their flocks, herds, and everything they own. They’re in Goshen now.” 🐑
He chose five of his brothers and brought them before Pharaoh. 👑
Pharaoh asked them, “What work do you do?” They answered, “Your servants are shepherds, just like our fathers were.” 🐑

They added, “We came to live here as foreigners because there’s no pasture for our flocks. The famine in Canaan is severe. Please let your servants settle in Goshen.” They explained why they needed refuge. 🙏
Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Your father and brothers have come to you.” 🏛️

“Egypt is open to you. Settle your father and brothers in the best part of the land; let them live in Goshen. If any are capable, put them in charge of my livestock.” Pharaoh welcomed the whole family. 🌾
Joseph brought his father Jacob in and presented him to Pharaoh. Jacob blessed Pharaoh. 🙏
Pharaoh asked Jacob, “How old are you?” ⏳
Jacob answered, “My years as a traveler have been 130. My life has had hardship, and it hasn’t reached the years my fathers lived on their journeys.” He spoke honestly about a difficult road. 🕯️
Jacob blessed Pharaoh and then left his presence. 🙏
Joseph settled his father and brothers in Egypt, giving them property in the best part of the land—Rameses—as Pharaoh had commanded. 🏠
Joseph provided food for his father, his brothers, and everyone in his father’s household, according to each family’s size. No one was left out. 🧺
There was no food anywhere in the land. The famine was so severe that Egypt and Canaan were both worn down by hunger. 🌾
Joseph collected all the money in Egypt and Canaan in exchange for the grain people bought, then brought that money into Pharaoh’s house. 💰
When all the money was gone in Egypt and Canaan, the Egyptians came to Joseph: “Give us food! Why should we die right in front of you? We have no money left.” 😰
Joseph said, “Bring me your livestock. If your money is finished, I’ll give you food in exchange for your animals.” 🐄
They brought their livestock to Joseph, and he gave them food in exchange for horses, flocks, herds, and donkeys. He kept feeding them that way for the year. 🐎

When that year ended, they came back the next year and said, “We won’t hide anything from you, sir: all our money is gone, and our livestock now belongs to you. We have nothing left except our bodies and our land.” 😔
“Why should we and our land die in front of you? Buy us and our land in exchange for food. We’ll serve Pharaoh. Give us seed so we can live, not die, and so the land won’t become desolate.” 🌱
So Joseph acquired all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh, because the Egyptians sold their fields as the famine pressed them hard. The land became Pharaoh’s. ⚖️
Joseph moved the people into the cities, from one end of Egypt’s border to the other. 🏘️
He did not buy the priests’ land, because they received an allowance from Pharaoh and lived on what Pharaoh gave them. That’s why they didn’t sell their land. 🏛️
Joseph told the people, “Today I have acquired you and your land for Pharaoh. Here is seed for you; go sow the land.” 🌱
“At harvest, give one fifth to Pharaoh. The other four parts are yours—for seed, food for you and your households, and food for your children.” The arrangement set out each share. 🌾
They said, “You’ve kept us alive! May we find favor with you, sir; we’ll serve Pharaoh.” 🙏
Joseph made it a standing law in Egypt that Pharaoh would receive one fifth of the produce, a law that remained to this day. The priests’ land alone did not become Pharaoh’s. 📜
Israel lived in Goshen in Egypt. They acquired property there, had children, and grew into a very large family. 🌱
Jacob lived in Egypt for seventeen years. He lived 147 years in all. ⏳
As Israel’s death drew near, he called Joseph and said, “If I have your favor, put your hand under my thigh and promise to treat me faithfully and kindly. Please don’t bury me in Egypt.” 🕯️
“When I rest with my fathers, carry me out of Egypt and bury me where they are buried.” Joseph answered, “I’ll do as you’ve asked.” 🤝
Israel said, “Swear it to me.” Joseph swore, and Israel bowed at the head of his bed. 🙏
